title: High-resolution ALMA and HST imaging of κCrB: a broad debris disc around a post-main-sequence star with low-mass companions
question: Is the debris disc around the post-main-sequence star kappa CrB a single or multiple component debris disc, and how have possible disc-planet interactions carved the disc?

recipe.goal: Calibrate, average, reweight, and image ALMA Band 6 continuum visibilities
recipe.method: Calibrate visibilities with standard ALMA pipeline, inspect with plotms, purge calibrators, time average into 10-second bins, channel average into 4 channels per spectral window, run statwt to estimate visibility weights from variance, and image continuum with tclean using natural weighting.
key_parameters: time averaging = 10-second bins; channel averaging = 4 channels per spectral window; weighting = natural

recipe.goal: Extract empirical disc geometry, radial profile, and fluxes from the ALMA Band 6 continuum image
recipe.method: Measure PA by maximising total flux in 5 deg wedges within 250 au; subtract unresolved stellar emission with a 2D Gaussian matched to the beam and fit elliptical rings within 3-sigma contours to measure inclination; compute deprojected azimuthally averaged radial surface brightness and integrated flux profiles.

recipe.goal: Reduce HST/STIS coronagraphic images and extract scattered light radial profiles and albedo
recipe.method: Register and median-combine STIS WEDGEA0.6 and WEDGEA2.0 images, subtract sky background and reference PSF star HD 139323, remove horizontal band artifact, derotate to North up, and extract radial surface brightness and r^2-scaled profiles in 10 deg wedges.
key_parameters: WEDGEA2.0 IWA >= 1.7'' (51 au); conversion 1 cts sec^-1 pix^-1 = 177 uJy arcsec^-2
assumptions: PA = 146 deg, i = 40 deg for radial profile extraction; F = 2923 mJy, f = 5e-5, d_phi = 2-8'' for albedo estimation

recipe.goal: Fit the spectral energy distribution (SED) of star and disc
recipe.method: Fit multi-wavelength photometry (including ALMA Band 6 total flux) with a stellar photosphere plus a single-component modified blackbody following Kennedy et al. (2014) and Yelverton et al. (2019).
key_parameters: WISE1 and WISE2 excluded due to error flags
assumptions: 2% calibration uncertainties on stellar luminosity and radius; modified blackbody modified by (lambda/lambda_0)^-beta_0 beyond lambda_0

recipe.goal: Parametric visibility modelling of the ALMA Band 6 continuum emission
recipe.method: Compute dust temperatures and 1.3 mm model images with RADMC-3D for two radial surface density parameterisations (power-law 'SPL' with 9 free parameters and Gaussian 'SGR' with 8 free parameters), transform to model visibilities at the observed uv-baselines, and fit using MCMC with emcee.
key_parameters: Free parameters: M_dust, r_1, i, PA, F_*_B6, x_off, y_off, plus (p_SPL, r_2) for SPL or (sigma_SGR) for SGR; N_Dat = 12,104,328
assumptions: Vertical aspect ratio h = H/r = 0.05 (fixed); circular orbits; grain sizes a_min = 1.0 um to a_max = 1 cm with power-law index alpha = 3.5; grain density rho = 2.7 g cm^-3; weighted mean dust opacity kappa = 1.88 cm^2 g^-1 (15% water-ice, 70% astrosilicates, 15% amorphous carbon)

recipe.goal: Grid modelling of the HST scattered light emission
recipe.method: Generate a grid of 0.6 um scattered light models based on the SPL power-law geometry using Henyey-Greenstein phase functions (and Mie theory test), apply a null map mask, scale by a dummy flux pre-factor, and minimise reduced chi^2 against the HST image.
key_parameters: r_in = 73 au, r_out = 280 au, PA = 148 deg; grid over i = 25 to 60 deg (step 5 deg), g = 0.1 to 0.9 (step 0.1), gamma = -2 to 2 (step 0.5)
assumptions: Henyey-Greenstein scattering phase function (also tested spherical grains with Mie theory)

recipe.goal: Extract CO J=2-1 upper limits and constrain CO gas mass and planetesimal ice fraction
recipe.method: Subtract continuum with uvcontsub, image dirty cube with tclean (0 iterations), apply Keplerian spectro-spatial filtering mask in both rotation directions over 0-60 au and 60-240 au to measure 3-sigma integrated flux upper limit, and compute NLTE CO gas mass upper limits.
key_parameters: Delta v = 1.269 km s^-1; effective bandwidth factor = 2.667; integration regions = 0-60 au and 60-240 au; gas temperatures = 10, 20, 50, 100 K
assumptions: v_rad = -24.98 +/- 0.14 km s^-1; M_* = 1.8 M_sun (also tested 1.32 M_sun); PA = 146 deg; i = 61 deg; unshielded CO photodissociation timescale = 120 yr

recipe.goal: Constrain planetary system architecture and collisional belt mass using RV, Gaia astrometry, and disc geometry
recipe.method: Fit 17 years of RV data (236 data points) for N=0, 1, 2 planets with RadVel; combine the residual linear RV trend, Gaia DR2-eDR3 proper motion anomaly limit, and chaotic zone non-overlap with the 93-151 au belt to bound companion masses and semi-major axes; derive minimum planetesimal size and total belt mass from collisional cascade equations.
key_parameters: N_data = 236 RV points; system age = 2.5 Gyr; belt inner edge = 93 au
assumptions: M_* = 1.8 +/- 0.3 M_sun; gamma = 1 for PMA limit; Q*_D ~ 70 J kg^-1, v_rel = 660 +/- 130 m s^-1, rho = 2.7 g cm^-3, belt width = 50 au for collisional cascade calculation
